lines.text: The LORD tells Eliphaz to take seven bulls and seven rams to Job and sacrifice a burnt offering.
Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar do as the LORD told them, and the LORD accepts Job's prayer.
After Job prays for his friends, the LORD doubles his possessions, and each visitor gives him a young lamb and a jar of oil.

wrong_details.wrong: a young lamb and a jar of oil
wrong_details.true: a piece of silver and a gold ring

lines.text: Job owns 14,000 sheep and 6,000 camels, has seven sons and three daughters, and names his first daughter Keziah.
Job lives 140 years, sees his children to the fourth generation, and dies old and full of years.
